name: High Fashion Hellions
source:
After finishing your last concert, you wake with no memory of the previous few nights, and no clues as to what you were up to. You soon find yourself thrust into a mystery when cryptic messages hint at a sinister link between your fame, a string of disappearances, and a secretive "fan club". 

Determined to unravel the truth, you embark on a dangerous investigation, facing the perilous reality that when it comes to showbiz, not everything is what it seems, and everyone has their secrets- some worth taking to the grave.
